title: Galaxy S8 Dexcom G5 - Android 9 - Causing Bluetooth Connection Issue
symptom: After updating to Android 9, xDrip+ loses connection to Dexcom G5, especially when screen is locked/off. Error message: 'Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 300'.
fix: One user reported that updating to the newest nightly build (April 1) seemed to fix the issue, getting data overnight with screen locked. Another user found a combination of settings that worked: Turned off OB1 Collector, DeveloperOptions Bluetooth 1.3, Unchecked 'force G5 to UI Thread', Checked 'Authenticate G5 before each read'.
settings_changed: force G5 to UI Thread → unchecked
Authenticate G5 before each read → checked
evidence_quote: Currently I'm collecting with the following - Turned off OB1 Collector - DeveloperOptions Bluetooth 1.3 - Unchecked "force G5 to UI Thread" - Checked "Authenticate G5 before each read"
